description: data.gov.il is an open data portal listed in data.gov.il, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of Israel (data.gov.il). data.gov.il is the national open data portal of Israel, run by the Ministry of Justice. It lists about 1,200 data sets in Hebrew, English and Arabic from ministries, authorities and municipalities. Coverage: Israel. 1,199 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 202 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-il-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
